name: Linear social card — minimal wordmark lockup on dark gradient by linear.app
description: A 1200×630 social card that is essentially pure brand: a single centered lockup of a white circular mark with diagonal slits next to a bold white wordmark, floating on a near-black canvas that lightens into a soft grey glow toward the bottom. No headline, tagline or imagery — the restraint and the ambient vertical gradient do all the work, making the logo read instantly at small share sizes.
